The '''Mk 3e/S medium blaster cannon''' was a type of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. They could be commonly found as the rear mounted weapon on [[Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle/Legends|Ultra-Light Assault Vehicles]].
